content_of_post_to_comment: Why does no matter what you do nothing makes you feel happy and truly confident until you physically make a decision and act on it. Like for many years I've been asking my fear and I just continued do other things but no amount of satisfaction came. It's like this feeling you crave to get but you never get. And I'm guessing the excitement and joy and burst of energy will only come the day I overcome my fear. I bought many things lately thinking I'll get joy but nothing really came out just feels like true feeling will come the day I face my fear. Like imagine you always wanted to get a college degree and it was a wish or dream for years but you never worked on it maybe you did but you failed and just put it off however the soul just desires you get that degree. That's how I feel
comment: I think there’s something real about the gap between wanting something and proving to yourself that you’ll actually move toward it. Buying things can give a quick distraction, but it usually can’t replace the feeling of keeping a promise you made to yourself. At the same time, sometimes we put huge pressure on the “big moment” of facing the fear, when small actions toward it can start rebuilding that confidence too.
